newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends firm on capital inflows.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends firm on capital inflows.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed markedly firmer at 484.50/485.50 per dollar on the back of a soaring stock market and strong capital inflows, trader said.
The unit closed Monday at 485.25/486.00 per dollar. Tuesday was a market holiday.
"That (capital inflows) is the logical reason as interest rates are very low and the interbank market very liquid," said one trader.

The bolsa's index pushed ahead 2.5 percent Wednesday to its fifth straight record high as yields on benchmark six month TEM rates fell 85 basis points to 21.66 percent in the Central Bank's regular Wednesday auction.
